The route must pass through the required points A (Vertiport Chicago Heliport) at (2462, -4210), B (Chicago Helicopter Experience Heliport) at (4271, -5759); visit A before B. Maintain an altitude between 20 and 120 meters at every waypoint. Avoid all restricted zones and obstacles (Z1 [Chicago Midway International Airport (KMDW, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [Chicago O'Hare International Airport (KORD, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [Chicago Executive Airport (KPWK, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]), including the straight paths between waypoints.
